text.p: - The "New Russians", owners of private shops are unhappy about new local trade regulations and are going on strike in the southern Russian province of Belgorod.
- The Federation Council is going to debate and very likely adopt the 1997 budget.
- The forthcoming visits of Israeli and Palestinian leaders to Moscow will be a serious test of Russian foreign policy.
- Despite high expectations of the Chechen leaders, foreign representatives are unlikely to attend the inauguration ceremony of the new Chechen president.
- The State Duma has adopted in a first reading the law on Russia's territorial integrity which should clearly define the mechanism of keeping the borders unchanged.

- A state budget is the main means parliament has to influence real economic policy, so the Federation Council should not rush to adopt it, says the deputy chairman of the upper house of the Russian parliament.
- Legal regulations on land rent in Moscow are very complicated and give enormous power to city bureaucrats.
